card.name: Gaps before study and table numbers
card.fires_on: Mostly the space before a number after "Study" or "Table", and the middle of "concomitant" ("Con<<com>>itant"). Also fires on a few other mid-sentence words in drug-label text.

modes.label: Space before a number
modes.description: The space token between "Study" or "Table" and its number.
